metadata.evidence_class: simulated (assumed tier parameters; NOT hardware, NOT measured, no CXL hardware involved)

scenarios.agentic_loop: each session is followed by a fixed successor with probability 0.85 (tool-call chains), otherwise a random jump: a first-order predictor can learn it
scenarios.zipf_iid: independent draws, Zipf(1.1) popularity: reuse exists, but the next session is not predictable beyond popularity
scenarios.uniform: independent uniform draws over all sessions: no reuse structure, any prefetch is mostly wasted
scenarios.phase_shift: a working set of 10 sessions, redrawn every 250 requests, uniform inside the phase: placement matters, prediction is weak

metadata.statistics: mean over seeds with t-based 95% CI; paired difference vs baseline on identical traces; 'significant' = CI excludes 0 (no multiple-comparison correction)
metadata.predictor: causal first-order Markov with popularity fallback; accuracy = running share of correct top-1 predictions
